items.heading: Ugali with Nyama Choma
details: Key ingredients: corn flour, water, goat or beef, salt
Whisk corn flour into boiling water, stirring until stiff and smooth (ugali).
Season meat simply with salt.
Grill the meat over charcoal until charred and tender.
Serve the ugali alongside the grilled meat and a tomato relish.

items.heading: Zanzibar Mix (Urojo)
details: Key ingredients: cassava, potato, mango sauce, bhajia
Boil cassava and potato until tender.
Prepare a tangy mango and turmeric sauce.
Fry crisp potato bhajia fritters.
Combine everything in a bowl with the tangy sauce poured over.

items.heading: Zanzibar Pizza
details: Ingredients: flour, yeast, water, salt, olive oil, tomato sauce, cheese and toppings.
Make a yeast dough, rest until doubled, stretch thin, add sauce and toppings, then bake in a very hot oven until browned.

details: Ingredients: flour, water, salt and fat; yeast or leavening when required.
